baseline_description: HC-1.0 through HC-1.5 are merged. The observed ReAssure 3.0 gaps are corrected and validated, and the broad Health domain catalogue seed is present. Historical Product #5 remains REPEATABILITY_NOT_PROVEN.

experiment.central_question: After the evidence-earned HC-1 extensions are frozen, can the Health Foundation manufacture and certify the same two target concepts for a new neutral unseen Health product without adding runtime logic or a new semantic/spec structural shape?
experiment.purpose: Independent cold-start validation of the post-HC-1 Health manufacturing architecture before considering Motor readiness.

target_clause_content_must_not_be_read_b: room-rent or cost-sharing clauses used to infer copayment fit
benefit or underwriting clauses used to infer waiting-period fit
eligible_product_rules: The product must be a currently offered Indian retail Health indemnity product for individual and/or family-floater purchase.
The insurer must not be one of the prior Health cold-start insurers: Star Health, Bajaj Allianz/Bajaj General, HDFC ERGO, Tata AIG, or Niva Bupa.
An official insurer or regulator source must expose a current policy wording and a stable product identifier/UIN before semantic review begins.
The exact UIN/product identifier must have no governed product evidence, semantic binding, certification fixture, or prior cold-start result in the repository at the baseline commit.
A name-only mention without ingested governed product evidence does not by itself make a product ineligible, but it must be disclosed in the selection record.
selection_protocol.candidate_enumeration_rule: Enumerate every product that can be verified to satisfy all eligible_product_rules using metadata only. Record each eligible candidate and each excluded candidate with its exclusion reason before target-clause review.
deterministic_tie_break: Normalize insurer legal/display name to lower-case ASCII for sorting.
Sort eligible candidates by normalized insurer name ascending.
Within an insurer, sort by normalized UIN/product identifier ascending.
Select the first candidate in that ordered list.
selection_protocol.selection_failure_rule: If deterministic selection cannot be executed because authoritative metadata is insufficient or the eligible universe cannot be enumerated reproducibly, record SELECTION_INCONCLUSIVE and stop. Do not hand-pick an apparently convenient product.

REUSE.rule: The baseline generic contract, binder, certifier, semantic type, governed spec schema, and evidence-attribution shape handle the selected product concept unchanged. Product-specific source/evidence records and new instances of baseline schemas are allowed and expected.

CONFIG_SPEC.rule: Frozen runtime remains unchanged, but faithful representation requires a new governed declarative structural shape that did not exist at the baseline. No executable decision logic may be hidden in that structure.

REPRESENTATION_GAP.rule: Authoritative evidence is sufficient, but the baseline runtime and declarative structures cannot represent or certify the semantic shape faithfully. The initial attempt must stop and record the gap before any extension is designed.

KNOWLEDGE_GAP.rule: Reviewed authoritative/corroborating evidence is insufficient to determine the concept. Code, config, glossary knowledge, and domain catalogue maturity must not compensate.

anti_gaming_rules: Product selection is based only on preregistered metadata criteria and deterministic ordering.
No target-concept clause may be inspected before the selection record is committed.
No candidate may be excluded because its wording appears complex, unfamiliar, likely to fail, or likely to require a new semantic shape.
No candidate may be preferred because its wording resembles an already-certified product.
New product-specific instances of an existing baseline schema remain REUSE, not CONFIG_SPEC merely because a new file exists.
A newly invented declarative structural shape is CONFIG_SPEC even if expressed only as JSON/YAML.
Product-specific computation, branching, precedence execution, or executable decision tables in config are runtime-in-exile and fail the experiment.
A newly named generic-looking runtime abstraction created after product selection fails the initial frozen-runtime attempt.
No KNOWLEDGE_GAP may be converted to absence, zero, non-application, or a default value without affirmative evidence.
HC-1.5 DomainKnowledge maturity may help explain vocabulary but cannot satisfy product-instance evidence requirements.

success_bar.STRONG_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.MINIMUM_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are scoreable as REUSE or CONFIG_SPEC, at least one is REUSE, no REPRESENTATION_GAP occurs, and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_NOT_PROVEN: Any primary metric is non-zero, any target concept is REPRESENTATION_GAP, or both scoreable concepts are CONFIG_SPEC with zero REUSE.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one target concept is KNOWLEDGE_GAP and no architecture/repeatability failure otherwise occurs.
success_bar.SELECTION_INCONCLUSIVE: The preregistered eligible universe or deterministic selection cannot be established from authoritative metadata without inspecting target-clause content.

required_artifacts_before_semantic_revie: committed Product #6 selection record containing the complete metadata-only candidate ledger
selected product identity and UIN/product identifier
repository exposure check at the baseline commit
official source URL checkpoint without target-clause excerpts

motor_readiness_gate.motor_readiness_review_may_begin_only_if: Product #6 reaches STRONG_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN or MINIMUM_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN under this frozen protocol.
motor_readiness_gate.if_not_proven: Remain in Health and address the observed result under the protocol; do not use a post-gap corrective validation as a substitute for a new neutral repeatability proof.
